highlights.title: Describe what you need, get a team
highlights.text: Write what your bots should do and press Suggest a team. You get 2 to 6 bots to untick or rename before you create them, and you can undo it.

highlights.title: Done while you were away
highlights.text: The Inbox now has two groups: Needs you, and what your bots finished while you were away. Done items stay for 7 days, and the badge counts only unread ones.

highlights.title: See what a bot did and why
highlights.text: Each done item shows the answer, a trail of what the bot did with times, and why it ran. Press Looks good, or ask the bot to redo it.

highlights.title: A stopped bot carries on or asks you
highlights.text: When a reply in your chat stops, the bot continues by itself, or you get one line in the chat and one item in Needs you, with Retry or Continue.

highlights.title: Your kwant version in one card
highlights.text: Settings says if you're on the latest kwant. Update installs a new version in the Mac app; on a server you get one command to copy.

highlights.title: Sign in to Google in kwant's Chrome
highlights.text: kwant's Chrome now presents itself as normal Chrome. If Google still refuses a sign-in, Sign in in Chrome opens a window for it on a computer with a screen, then goes back to no window.

fixes: A new space's Get started card names that space's own bots, not the main space's starter bots.
If kwant's Chrome closes right after starting, you're told why at once, with Chrome's last lines, not after a timeout.
A mission task that finds the browser busy waits and tries again twice by itself, instead of failing at once.
